Definition: from G4314 and G305; to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat):--go up.
BiblicalUsage: Prosanabaino means to go up higher, to be promoted to a better place. Jesus uses it in His parable of the feast: take the lowest room, and when the host comes he will say, Friend, go up higher.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honour in God's house is given, never grabbed, and the lowest seat is the safest place to wait for it.
